items.title: OpenAI's Q3 results and Nvidia's scandal impact on the AI ecosystem
items.summary:
Deidre Bosa is joined by Khosla Ventures Founder Vinod Khosla to discuss OpenAI's (OPAI.PVT) Q3 results from an investor perspective, how OpenAI compares with Anthropic (ANTH.PVT), and how the Nvidia scandal impacts the AI ecosystem.

Deidre Bosa then sits down with OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar to discuss OpenAI's push into enterprise AI, their 'dots' rollout, and the global AI model race.

'Deirdre Bosa Live' airs every day at 4 p.m. Tune in daily to hear how the latest developments in AI and technology are reshaping companies, industries, and the global economy.

items.title: California Privacy Agency Fines FedEx Nearly $3M
items.summary: California has fined FedEx nearly $3 million over alleged privacy violations - including failing to honor opt-out commands sent through the Global Privacy Control.

items.title: Why the Data Center Backlash Could Fall Flat: Increased Costs “a Trade That These Hyperscalers Are Still Going to Want to Make”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysTexas governor-elect Gina Hinojosa plans to make newly permitted data centers pay taxes, avoid raising consumer power prices and use union labor. Gene Munster puts soft costs at about 15% of a data center’s bill, so a 30% jump in them raises the total only about 5%.
